text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(The vaunted Tracen Academy attracts
only the most gifted of
students.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Those born with exceptional racing
instincts. Those whose greatest
purpose in
life is to run. Those who never stop
climbing to greater
and greater heights.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And me... What can I become here?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Then, one day... one fateful day...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky is shooting farther and farther
ahead! Three lengths, now
four lengths in
front—there's no stopping her!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Can we really call this a mere scrimmage?
What a show of strength
from Maruzensky!
And now, she flies across the finish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(A flash of light darted past... and lit up
my world.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few months later...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm taking a stroll early one morning, I
see students doing some
light running on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nice going. Your form was perfect! But
those last 400 meters had you
lagging
behind your target pace.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe aiming for such a fast pace
right off the bat wasn't a
good idea. I'll
hold off on that until my cardio improves a
bit more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, tomorrow I'll dial down the pace
and work back up little by
little!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes, that sounds like a plan. Now, I
will say... call me biased,
but you've
improved quite a lot recently.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you! Actually, I think you're
right—it's like I've sprouted
and shot up all
at once!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I keep working at it step by step, then
s-someday, I... I might even
be able to go
toe to toe with Maruzen... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Or not! Ahaha, forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, I think that's a wonderful dream. Oh,
it's about time for breakfast.
Were you
planning on...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I still have some drills to get through,
so I'll head over once I'm
done! Thank you
so much, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No worries. I'll go on ahead, then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All right, let's see what's left...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Muttering intently to herself, the young
racer scribbles away in her
notebook. As I
watch with curiosity, I hear footsteps
approaching.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
That kid there caught your interest,
Trainer? Her name's Sakura
Chiyono O.
She was with a friend today, but usually
she's at it all by
herself.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
You won't see her doing back-to-back hill
sprints or anything like
that, but she's here
running every single morning, and makes
sure to
reflect on it after.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Through trial and error, she gets a little
faster each day, improving
slowly but
surely. Well, all I'm trying to say is... you
might like to think
about scouting her!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You know, you might be right. I do
watch her every morning.
Ah, just seeing
her hard at work puts a spring in my step.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Gotta love being out on a nice
day... Oh, I got one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The morning sun is an Umamusume's best
growth hormone"! Hehe,
nice one, me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A gust of wind snatches up her notebook
and delivers it to my feet. I
catch a
glimpse of pages packed to the margins
with writing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
M-my Chiyonotes! Sorry about that! Thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... it's like my entire life squeezed
into notebook form! That's
why I call it my
Chiyonotes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Any lessons I learn, facts I find out, or
sayings I come up with, I write
in here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I'm really nothing special... so I
just try to do what little I can,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've admired you ever since I started here!
When I saw you run, it was
love at first
sight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O grips a letter in her shaking
hands, cheeks flushed bright
red. I get the
feeling I shouldn't be witnessing this and
quickly hide
myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
One day... one day, I want to stand by
your side! That's my dream! So
for now, I
just want to get closer to you, one step at
a time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm nowhere near good enough to
earn that spot yet! But... but
please give
me a chance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please do a practice race with me,
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should say more about what
exactly I like about her
running. No, that
might be too mu—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curiosity getting the better of me, I peek
my head out only to find
that Chiyono O is
talking to herself. As I'm taken aback by
this, our
eyes meet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: D-did you hear all that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, uhh... WAHHH! You saw nothing!
